adapterLine.skill: On GitHub Copilot, read [the Copilot adapter](../pstack-copilot/SKILL.md) once per session before you follow this skill. It maps the Cursor names in pstack skills to GitHub Copilot.
adapterLine.agent: On GitHub Copilot, read the `pstack-copilot` skill once per session before you follow this file. It is `pstack-copilot/SKILL.md` in the same skills folder as `poteto-mode`: `~/.copilot/skills/`, `.github/skills/`, or `~/.pstack/current/skills/`. It maps the Cursor names in pstack to GitHub Copilot.
